construct: Botulinum neurotoxin light chains cleave SNARE proteins required for fusion of acetylcholine-containing vesicles with the presynaptic membrane, preventing acetylcholine release and causing descending flaccid paralysis.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Foodborne exposure followed by cranial neuropathies, autonomic dry mouth, and symmetric descending flaccid weakness with intact sensation is botulism. Botulinum neurotoxin cleaves presynaptic SNARE proteins and blocks acetylcholine release.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Myasthenia gravis is postsynaptic AChR autoimmunity; Lambert-Eaton targets presynaptic P/Q calcium channels; acetylcholinesterase inhibition causes cholinergic excess; tetanus cleaves SNARE proteins in inhibitory interneurons and causes spasticity.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The only superficially similar SNARE distractor is tetanus, but the direction of paralysis and neuronal target are opposite, leaving botulinum SNARE cleavage at cholinergic terminals as the single best answer.
